Solution 2 has the correct final answer. The correct modulo $7$ remainder of the sum $1+3+5+7+9+\dots+195+197+199$ is 5. 

Solution 1 incorrectly ignores the contribution of the last two terms, while Solution 3 incorrectly assumes every pair of terms adds up to $200$. The correct approach is to recognize that the sequence of remainders cycles every $7$ terms, and the sum of any complete cycle of $7$ numbers is $21$, which gives a remainder of $0$ when divided by $7$. The only terms not part of such a complete cycle are $197$ and $199$, whose sum also has a remainder of $5$ when divided by $7$.
